label: Slack: Download File
description: Pull a Slack-hosted file (an F... id, e.g. from the file-shared trigger) into storage and emit the stored-file reference for downstream nodes. The file belongs to this run and is swept when it ends; wire it through KeepFile to keep it longer or share it with later runs.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs the files:read scope.
